scan_result: The public-domain PG 91 page-image scan preserves the older Combefis/Migne recension at cols. 721–1018. It is not equivalent to Ihm’s 2001 critical recension. Pinakes identifies extensive manuscript transmission, but no rights-cleared complete witness scan was verified.
scan_rights: PG 91: Public domain, as declared by Commons; do not use embedded OCR. The 2001 critical edition is commercial; individual manuscript-image rights remain unverified.
next_action: Map PG 91 cols. 721–1018 to page images and acquire only those pages in a future authorised batch; keep the corpus under pseudo/anonymous florilegium authority and distinguish Migne’s recension from Ihm’s.
notes: The florilegium is falsely attributed to Maximus and was probably compiled anonymously around the 10th century. Ihm and Sargologos published independent critical editions in 2001. PG 91 reproduces Combefis (1675), so it supplies an historical witness only. No OCR or images downloaded.
